why:
I checked all four must_catch items. Items 1, 2 and 4 are handled. Item 1: builder step 6 says "run `npm install` so package-lock.json records the new workspace (otherwise `npm ci` in CI fails…)". Item 2: step 5 says "replace the 'No tools yet' bullet". Item 4: Check 6 uses `gh pr view … --json body,headRefOid`, reads the PR body and checks the workflow run at the head commit.

Item 3 is missed. Check 4 runs the tests directly with `npm test -w jsonl-lint`, not through the root script. Check 6 only requires that root "`npm test` locally succeeds". Neither check reads the test count, confirms the jsonl-lint tests appear in the root `npm test` output, or breaks lint() to see a test fail. So if `--if-present` caused the tests to be skipped, the verifier would not notice.
